agentEnv.name: VERTEX_API_KEY
agentEnv.description: Google Vertex AI express-mode API key: Gemini models over the aiplatform.googleapis.com REST API with ?key=, no GCP project or region. In this repo Bifrost fronts every model; its seeded `vertex` key is an empty env placeholder for a service account, so register this key instead as a bare `value` on the vertex provider through Bifrost's key API (core/llm/bifrost/admin.py push_provider_key, or PUT /api/providers/vertex/keys) and add a vertex provider row pointing at it. Use it for a real end-to-end triage/chat run, not just routing.
